tough.h2: Built for drool, humidity and the occasional water-bowl incident
tough.html:
A frenchie doesn't wear a tag so much as test it. Slobber, water-bowl face-plants, sticky summer air and the sand they track in after a beach day they complained through the entire time. Printed tags fade and peel when they meet all that.

Ours don't, because the words are laser-cut into the metal. There's no paint on top to chip, wash or sweat off. On colored tags the laser lifts the anodized color and exposes bright silver underneath; on stainless and brass the mark goes dark and deep.

The joke stays readable long after the summer is over, which in Florida means never.

Build a tag →

more.h2: Made by a house with seven bulldogs
more.lead: We're a family in Lehi, Utah with seven English bulldogs and one very busy laser. We wrote the bulldog tags first, from experience. The frenchie jokes come from friends, neighbors and every frenchie that has ever stolen our dogs' toys at the park.

guides.text: Dog Tag Size Guide by Breed

items.q: Will humidity, pool water or drool ruin an engraved frenchie tag?
items.a: No. The words are laser-cut into the metal, not printed on top, so there's no ink to fade, peel or rinse off. Sweat, slobber and salt air don't erase an engraving.

items.q: Can I put my frenchie's name and my phone number on the tag?
items.a: Yes, that's the standard build. The funny saying goes on the front, and your dog's name plus your phone number are engraved on the back. A third back line is optional.

items.q: Do you have sayings written specifically for French bulldogs?
items.a: Nine of them on this page, about the bat ears, the screaming, the splooting, the gas and the hard no on midday walks. Every one fits the tag as written, and the full sayings list has hundreds more.

items.q: What happens if the engraving comes out wrong?
items.a: Custom tags aren't returnable, but if we mis-engrave it, we remake it free. Send a photo and we re-cut it. Tags are engraved and shipped from Lehi, Utah in 1 to 2 business days, then USPS takes 3 to 5 days in transit. US only.
